title: Throw counts with and without confirmed centering passes

definitions.physical: Every physical pass attempt, including centering and incomplete throws.
definitions.attacking: Subtract one human-confirmed opening centering/setup pass; retain every pass in a direct opening attack or a possession after a turnover.
definitions.index: For a confirmed setup sequence, subtract one from each following physical throw number, including huck positions.
definitions.fieldPosition: Keep the original possession-start location; do not shift eligibility or matching to the receiving end of a centering pass.
definitions.sourceLocationLimit: Current x/y values are the first recorded throwing location, not independently verified exact pull-catch or pickup coordinates.
definitions.setupFailures: Keep the physical attempt and turnover. A possession ending on a failed setup can have zero attacking throws.
definitions.cohort: Same completed film-reviewed original-line possessions in both counts, separated into goals and turnovers. Stop at the first recorded lineup change, retain original possession numbers, and omit the two individually flagged end-of-quarter examples.
definitions.scopeLimit: A counting demonstration on deliberately selected reviews. Starts are not field-matched. These means are not league estimates or evidence of a team tendency. No inferential intervals or p-values are estimated.
definitions.uncertain: Do not automatically subtract from unreviewed or unresolved starts.
